description: Calculate water pressure loss in a pipe circuit including friction and elevation. Returns: {equiv_length_m}. See list_bundles for related 'plomberie' calculators.

elevation_change_m.description: Elevation change in meters (positive = uphill, negative = downhill)

fittings_count.description: Number of fittings and elbows (each adds ~0.5m equivalent length)

flow_rate_lpm.description: Flow rate in liters per minute

name: calculate_water_pressure_loss

formula.description: Human-readable formula or method used (e.g. "I=P·r·t", "Magnus formula").

reference_url.description: Link to a calcul2 page documenting the calculation in detail.

result.description: Computed result. Object whose fields depend on the tool (e.g. {tax, marginal_rate, brackets} for tax tools, {volume_l, gallons} for volume tools).

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").
